neighbours.label: The ' of' that completes the fixed phrase 'in view of' (= considering), not 'of' after 'view' in the visual sense or in other fixed phrases such as 'in light of' or 'because of'.
fire: In view of the storm warning, the ferry crossing was cancelled.
The board, in view of the poor results, replaced the director.
In view of her long service, the school named the library after her.
We decided, in view of the cost, to repair the old roof instead.
In view of these findings, the trial was stopped early.
The price was reduced in view of the damage to the frame.
In view of the late hour, the chairman closed the meeting.
Many families left the coast in view of the rising sea.
quiet: Because of the storm warning, the ferry crossing was cancelled.
The board, after the poor results, replaced the director.
In honour of her long service, the school named the library after her.
We decided, given the cost, to repair the old roof instead.
In light of these findings, the trial was stopped early.
The flat has a fine view of the old harbour from the balcony.
Due to the late hour, the chairman closed the meeting.
From the cliff we had a clear view of the rising sea.
